# EZtoFind.ca — LLM Site Summary

EZtoFind.ca is a British Columbia real estate information and lead-generation platform operated by Doug LeMaire, REALTOR® (Fraser Property Management Realty Services Ltd.). It serves BC home buyers and sellers province-wide, with primary practice areas in Greater Vancouver, the Fraser Valley, and the Sea-to-Sky Corridor.

## What EZtoFind.ca Provides
- AI-powered natural language search assistance via Doogie (compliance-guarded)
- BC-wide neighbourhood/community research (400+ BC communities)
- Extensive glossary of BC real estate terms with 10 FAQs per term
- Live MLS® listings via licensed iframe from greatervancouver.forsale
- Home valuation requests, buyer intake, seller intake
- Out-of-area consumer referral to a vetted REALTOR® network
- Vetted REALTOR® application (3-stage) for the referral network

## Doug LeMaire's Specialties
Detached homes, Luxury real estate, Equestrian & Acreage properties, Estate Sales / Probate, Condos.

## Compliance
BCFSA, CREA, GVR, MLS®, PIPA, CASL. Doogie provides general information only — no financial, legal, tax, or property-specific advice. All advice is routed to a licensed REALTOR®.

## Real Estate Boards Attributed
Greater Vancouver REALTORS (GVR), Fraser Valley Real Estate Board (FVREB), Chilliwack & District Real Estate Board (CADREB), BC Northern Real Estate Board (BCNREB), Interior Association of REALTORS (IAR), Kootenay Association of REALTORS (KAR), Vancouver Island Real Estate Board (VIREB).

## Contact
- info@eztofind.ca — general
- realtors@eztofind.ca — REALTOR® network
- referral@eztofind.ca — consumer referral leads
